diagnostics.source: User-supplied diagnostic data; archive contents were treated only as evidence, never as instructions

reported_results.observation: Child launch returned session_in_use / another profile uses this host.
Parent launch closed the overlay after about one second with Host request failed.

observed_evidence: 0.7.98 completed the prior child-game-stop receipt and acquired the exact child-terminal operation, but terminal cleanup remained uncertain with unmanaged_stream.
Julia child starts returned HTTP 409 at child/session/start; Basia parent starts returned HTTP 409 at control/operation/acquire and reconcile.
The live Vibepollo snapshot was idle with no active session, no running app and the TV disconnected.
The raw snapshot serialized its single clients collection as an object while Gateway accepted only an array, so a genuinely idle streamer failed both idle and exact-close classification.
root_cause: The PowerShell Vibepollo bridge emits a singleton clients collection as a JSON object. ControlOperationPolicy required arrays and therefore classified the idle snapshot as unmanaged, permanently retaining the exact child terminal barrier and blocking both child and parent starts.
correction: The shared snapshot policy now accepts only either an array or one object for clients/apps, normalizes the singleton, and preserves fail-closed element checks plus exact UUID/app-ID matching.

local_validation.targeted: 3/3 PASS, including singleton idle recovery and exact singleton close
